# KevTheDev — Kevin Heidema

> Kevin Heidema is a Shopify developer and AI automation specialist based in Surrey, BC, Canada. He builds Shopify stores, Hydrogen storefronts and custom Shopify apps, plus AI automation: agentic workflows, automated social content engines, and AI-ready websites (WebMCP, structured data, llms.txt).

The site is a single page at https://kevthedev.site/. It exposes WebMCP tools (`get_profile`, `get_services`, `get_work`, `show_section`, `contact_kevin`) through `document.modelContext` / `navigator.modelContext` in supporting browsers.

## Services

- Shopify development: store setup, Hydrogen / headless storefronts, custom Shopify apps, speed and performance, migration to Shopify (from WooCommerce, Squarespace and others)
- AI solutions: AI automation and agentic workflows, social content engine (generates, schedules and posts on-brand content), AI-ready websites (WebMCP, structured data, llms.txt)
- Integrations and support: third-party apps, CRMs and fulfillment systems; ongoing maintenance and support

## Work

- [Tuner Depot](https://tunerdepot.com): Shopify storefront for diesel performance parts and custom tunes
- [Binxie Bot](https://binxiebot.com): Shopify store for battery-free, screen-free tech kits, games and puzzle books that pair with free Binxie video lessons
- [Minpaku](https://minpaku.ca): custom booking site for a Japanese-style homestay in Coquitlam, BC, with a live CAD/JPY cost estimator
- Most other work (custom apps, AI workflows, internal tools) is under NDA

## Process

Discovery → Plan → Build → Launch → Iterate
